cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Not That Subject
cards.instruction: Choose one subject you cannot let the scene reach. Redirect whenever the conversation gets close.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. I've booked your car into that garage with the café. Shall we have breakfast there?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why does my car need a garage?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Their full breakfast includes unlimited toast. You always say that's important.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll look at the car while you order.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's take the bus. Then we can both have the breakfast cocktails.

mechanism: A uses lessons in practical composure to redirect a pupil away from discussing why its car needs repair.
confusable: It is topic avoidance, not merely offering breakfast: each teaching correction intercepts a route toward the damage.
comparison: Car repair inquiry hidden under breakfast instruction versus rent inquiry delayed through photography lessons.
seedUse: D14 garage/cafe invitation and concern about car remain, with S05 method replacing an unexplained bus maneuver.
